messages:
jordyn: PSA: someone watered Spike the cactus with a full mug this morning. Spike is not okay. :cactus:

sam: wait what. who would do that. was it the "you're my plant parent" cult?

viv: that was me. i thought it was a succulent. i apologize profusely. sending emergency soil prayers. :pray:

alex: viv nooooo. spike is a stoic boy. can we do CPR? or is that only for succulents?

kelly: plant-bot status?

plant-bot: plant-bot: moisture sensor for Spike reads 87% (danger). Recommended action: towel dry topsoil, re-pot to dry mix, reduce sympathy watering. :robot_face:

leo: i have spare gritty mix and a tiny shovel. can bring it to the kitchen in 15.

tasha: suggestion: cactus sobriety program. no water for 2 weeks, only cactus-friendly pep talks.

jordyn: also someone left a condolence sticky note: "Sorry for your loss. - Marketing". Spike is alive but shaken. please stop signing him up for meetings.

viv: offering to write an apology haiku and to buy spike a tiny sombrero as atonement.

sam: proposal: Spike Recovery Fund (money for soil + tiny sombrero). who's in? i'll seed $5.

kelly: in. will also donate a mini fan to dry him out faster.

alex: update: repotted Spike. less wet soil, more gravel. he looks less sad.

plant-bot: plant-bot: final moisture 42%. spike_status: recovering. recommended soundtrack: desert indie playlist.

jordyn: crisis averted. new office rule: don't water anything unless you've passed the Plant 101 quiz. i'll make a sign.

viv: quiz where i get exempted because im the one who caused this? :grimacing:

tasha: same quiz, with cactus-only module.

jordyn: Spike will accept donations of sunlight and quiet. no more mugs near his pot. :cactus::heart:
